titleEn: USDA launches data modernization pilot to improve crop reports
titleZh: 美国农业部启动数据现代化试点以提升作物报告准确性
summaryZh: 美国农业部宣布启动数据现代化试点项目，利用卫星影像、地理空间工具、作物模型及AI/机器学习技术，提升种植面积和产量估算的准确性。该计划不取代传统农户调查，而是与之并行运行，同时通过在线化问卷和预填数据提高回复率、减轻农户文书负担。农业部长Brooke Rollins在Farm Progress展会上宣布了这一消息，预计在本届政府任期内取得成果。
featuredReason: USDA数据现代化试点直接影响农业数据采集与分析方式，其卫星遥感、AI/机器学习与传统调查结合的模式，对智慧畜牧行业的数据平台建设、精准农业决策和养殖数据采集具有重要参考价值。

USDA launches data modernization pilot to improve crop reports

Farm Progress America: USDA launches data modernization pilot to improve crop reports

September 10, 2026

The USDA is taking steps to improve the accuracy of its agricultural data through a new pilot program announced by Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins at the Farm Progress show last week.

The data modernization plan addresses ongoing concerns from farmers and ag economists about the reliability of USDA reports. The initiative will evaluate advanced satellite imagery, geospatial tools and crop models to sharpen acreage and yield estimates. The department will also explore artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities.

Importantly, these technological advances won't replace traditional farmer surveys. Instead, the new technology will run alongside producer-reported information, with the USDA testing methods to ground truth its yield numbers.

Scott Hutchins, undersecretary for research, education and economics at the USDA, emphasized that improving response rates is crucial. The agency plans to make surveys easier to complete by putting them online and pre-populating fields with data the department already has.

Related:Husker Harvest Days returns to Grand Island next week

Iowa farmer Jeff Lundorf told Reuters that "some of these methods haven't changed since the 1970s," adding that he's optimistic about the modernization efforts, though he noted these are big projects for one administration to tackle.

The modernization effort also focuses on reducing paperwork burden for producers. Hutchins said the agency expects to have results by the end of the current term. Additional listening sessions with producers are scheduled for this fall to continue gathering farmer input on the program.

translationZh:
美国农业部正在采取措施，通过一项新的试点项目来提高其农业数据的准确性。该项目由农业部长Brooke Rollins上周在Farm Progress展会上宣布。

这项数据现代化计划回应了农户和农业经济学家对USDA报告可靠性的持续担忧。该计划将评估先进的卫星影像、地理空间工具和作物模型，以提升种植面积和产量估算的精度。该部门还将探索人工智能和机器学习能力。

重要的是，这些技术进步不会取代传统的农户调查。相反，新技术将与生产者报告的信息并行运行，USDA将测试各种方法来对其产量数据进行实地验证。

USDA研究、教育和经济事务副部长Scott Hutchins强调，提高回复率至关重要。该机构计划通过将调查问卷放到网上，并用部门已有的数据预填字段，使调查更容易完成。

**相关：Husker Harvest Days下周重返Grand Island**

爱荷华州农户Jeff Lundorf对路透社表示，“其中一些方法自1970年代以来就没有改变过”，并补充说他对现代化努力持乐观态度，但他也指出，对于一届政府来说，这些都是大工程。

现代化努力还侧重于减少生产者的文书负担。Hutchins表示，该机构预计在本届任期结束前取得成果。今年秋季还计划与生产者举行更多意见听取会，继续收集农户对该项目的意见。
